subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the old apartment living room in <Picture 1>: a worn beige fabric sofa with a light-grey knitted blanket, a cream-white wall, a window with white sheer curtains on the right letting in warm afternoon sunlight, a small light-wood coffee table with a black phone lying on it.
<Subject 2> is the fat blue cat in <Picture 1>, a very fat British Shorthair with solid blue-grey short fur, big chubby cheeks, round copper-orange eyes and a narrow red collar; <Picture 3> is a close-up of its face.
<Subject 3> is the fat orange cat in <Picture 1>, a very fat orange tabby with a round face, round amber eyes, a pink nose, a white chin and chest, and a narrow dark-blue collar with a small bell; <Picture 2> is a close-up of its face.

summary:
[reference generation] In <Subject 1> on a lazy afternoon, <Subject 2> asks <Subject 3> why it got even fatter; <Subject 3> explains it eats when the market drops and celebrates when it rises, and says it will lose weight on the day it breaks even; both cats burst out laughing. Five shots, realistic live-action comedy with two real cats talking in Mandarin.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic, warm live-action comedy in natural afternoon light, steady handheld-looking camera, vertical frame, shot like a real phone video of two real cats: fur, whiskers and eyes stay exactly as real cats, and when a cat speaks its mouth moves only a little, like a real cat chattering, with small jaw movements and no human-like lips or teeth. <Subject 3> sits on the left side of the sofa and <Subject 2> on the right side throughout; their left-right positions never swap. <Subject 2> (S1) speaks in a clear, slightly deep, dry middle-aged male voice; <Subject 3> (S2) speaks in a lazy, drawling young male voice. All lines are in Mandarin Chinese.
[Shot 1] A wide shot of <Subject 1>. <Subject 3> sits on the left and <Subject 2> on the right on the knitted blanket, about half a metre apart, both in three-quarter profile facing each other and looking into each other's eyes. <Subject 2> (S1) leans its head toward <Subject 3>'s round belly, looks directly at <Subject 3> and says in a dry, disapproving tone, <d>[Chinese] 你最近怎么又胖一圈？</d> It closes its mouth and keeps staring at <Subject 3>. <Subject 3> keeps its mouth closed while listening, slowly lifts its chin and looks back at <Subject 2>.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.300, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 3> alone, centred in the frame with space above its ears, on the sofa, facing right toward the off-screen <Subject 2>. <Subject 3> (S2) raises its chin, looks at the off-screen <Subject 2> and says lazily and matter-of-factly, <d>[Chinese] 跌了我就吃，涨了我就庆祝。</d> It closes its mouth and licks its lips once.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 2> alone, centred in the frame with space above its ears, on the sofa, facing left toward the off-screen <Subject 3>. <Subject 2> (S1) narrows its eyes, the tip of its tail flicks once, it looks at the off-screen <Subject 3> and says in a tired, resigned tone, <d>[Chinese] 那你打算什么时候瘦？</d> It closes its mouth.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 3> alone, centred with space above its ears, face nearly frontal and turned a little to the right, eyes on the off-screen <Subject 2>. <Subject 3> (S2) suddenly turns serious, its eyes widen slightly and stay fixed on the off-screen <Subject 2>, and it says slowly and solemnly, <d>[Chinese] 回本那天。</d> It closes its mouth and holds the serious look for a short beat.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.800, the shot cuts back to the wide shot of <Subject 1>. <Subject 3> on the left and <Subject 2> on the right look at each other in silence for half a beat, then both cats burst out laughing together the way cats would: eyes squeezed shut, mouths open just a little, heads thrown back, bodies shaking with laughter; <Subject 3> rolls over onto its side on the blanket while still laughing, <Subject 2> shakes with laughter and paws at the blanket, until the end. No speech in this shot.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet apartment afternoon: faint traffic far outside the window, a curtain rustling lightly, the small bell on <Subject 3>'s collar tinkling when it moves, the cats' laughter in the last shot.
